narr: A slow moving storm system affected Central and South Louisiana with multiple days of heavy rain and a few severe storms.
ev: Cars were flooded in Mansura during heavy rain. At least one truck stalled in Hessmer.
Multiple roads were flooded around Ville Platte including Highway 167.
Secondary roads along Calcasieu and Cameron Parish line had minor flooding from excessive rainfall associated with thunderstorms.
Stream gages reported water over the banks of multiple ditches and bayous from Westlake, to Lake Charles, to near LeBleu Settlement. Multiple roadways were also flooded with some being impassable.
Excessive rain produced flooded and impassable roads in Kinder.

Multiple streets were flooded and impassable across St. Landry Parish but mostly around Opelousas and Washington. A store flooded in Palmetto and multiple homes flooded along the 2000 block of Highway 749. 7 to 8 inches of rain occurred during the event.
Multiple stream and ditch gages indicated minor flooding.
